# v5.0.0 — The 5.8 GB edition

**Released:** 2026-10-21 · **Previous release:** v4.1.0 (2026-08)

> **Breaking change.** The repository history was rewritten on 2026-10-21. Every commit and tag has a new SHA, and ~480 files moved. Existing clones and forks can no longer `git pull` — see [Upgrading](#upgrading) or [MIGRATION.md](MIGRATION.md).

---

## At a glance

| | v4.1.0 (Aug 2026) | v5.0.0 |
|---|---|---|
| Git repository | 9.55 GB | **5.68 GiB** |
| Checkout on disk | 10.23 GiB | **5.81 GiB** |
| Images | 3,087 | **2,685** |
| Videos | 36 | **18** |
| Top-level folders | 27 | **28** |
| PNG files | 703 (4.0 GiB) | **0** |
| WebP files | 4 | **641** |

Every removed image was an exact duplicate of one that remains in the collection.

---

## Why this release exists

The trigger was repository size: **9.55 GB of Git history for 10.23 GiB of files**, and 99.6% of the objects in that history were simply the current files.

That has three consequences worth knowing:

1. **`git clone --depth 1` did not help.** A shallow clone only drops dead history, and the whole repository contained exactly **11 unreachable blobs**.
2. **Every clone, fork, backup and CI checkout paid the full 9.5 GB.**
3. **Deleting files at the tip would not have shrunk anything**, because old commits still referenced their blobs. Only a history rewrite could actually drop them.

Where the weight was:

| Component | Size | What we did |
|---|---|---|
| JPEG wallpapers | 5.48 GiB | kept untouched — a second lossy pass on photos is not worth ~1.8 GB |
| PNG art | **4.00 GiB / 703 files** | re-encoded to WebP q92 → **0.39 GiB** |
| HEIC | 0.54 GiB | kept — already efficient |
| MOV | 0.24 GiB | kept |
| `Year of 2021/` | **1.1 GiB / 421 files** | deleted — byte-identical to `2021 Wallpaper/` |

Net: 3.6 GB from WebP, 1.1 GB from the duplicate tree, ~0.2 GB from pruning.

---

## Breaking changes

1. **History rewritten.** All 131 pre-existing commits and all 6 old tags have new SHAs. Messages, authors and dates are preserved; object IDs are not. Maintenance commits were added on top.
2. **Files moved.** 483 files were relocated into device lanes. Old `raw.githubusercontent.com` links now 404.
3. **PNG → WebP.** Every `.png` path is now `.webp` in the same folder. Scripts that glob `*.png` will silently match nothing.
4. **Duplicate tree removed.** `Year of 2021/` no longer exists — use `2021 Wallpaper/`.

---

## What's new

### Device lanes

| Folder | Images | Size | Contents |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Phone Wallpapers/` | 173 | 89.8 MiB | `iOS/`, `Android/`, `NASA Artemis II/`, `Misc/` |
| `Ultrawide Wallpapers/` | 185 | 486 MiB | `21x9/` (142) · `32x9/` (33) · `Panorama/` (10) |
| `Social Assets/` | 125 | 21.2 MiB | The Crew 2 press kit, avatars, stray downloads |

Ultrawide criterion: aspect ratio **≥ 2.05:1** and at least **2560 × 1000**.

### WebP re-encode

- 703 PNG images → WebP **quality 92**
- 4.00 GiB → **0.39 GiB**
- **121 ICC profiles** and **95 alpha-channel** images preserved
- JPEG, HEIC and MOV deliberately untouched

### Tooling and documentation

- `scripts/stats.py` — per-folder counts and sizes; `--check` keeps this README honest (runs in CI), `--write` fixes it
- `scripts/build_gallery.py` — local HTML gallery with lazy thumbnails (`gallery/`, gitignored)
- `scripts/heic2jpg.sh` — HEIC/HEIF → JPEG siblings for Windows/Linux
- `LICENSE` (MIT for code and prose, plus a media licensing notice) and `CONTRIBUTING.md`
- GitHub Actions workflow that runs `stats.py --check` on every push and PR
- `MIGRATION.md` — what changed, fixes A–D, and the old → new path table

---

## Quality report

Sample: 1600×900 Cyberpunk PNG → WebP q92.

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| PSNR | 38.06 dB |
| SSIM | 0.9823 |

Across a random 30-image sample: median **38.3 dB**, minimum **32.1 dB**. Indistinguishable at normal viewing distance; hard edges can look slightly soft at 1:1.

This is a **lossy, one-way conversion** — the original PNG masters are no longer in the repository. If you need them, recover them from an old clone before syncing.

---

## Upgrading

| Your situation | What to do |
|---|---|
| Existing clone, no local commits | `git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/main` |
| Fork, no custom commits | GitHub → **Sync fork** → **Discard commits** |
| Fork with your own commits | `git rebase --onto upstream/main 95d3b2c main` |
| Nothing yet | `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/MilesCorporate/The-Wallpaper-Collection.git` |

`95d3b2c` was the last commit of the old history. Full instructions, patch-based fallback and the old → new path table: **[MIGRATION.md](MIGRATION.md)**.

---

## Compatibility

| Format | Windows | macOS / Linux |
|---|---|---|
| **WebP** | Windows 11 native; Windows 10 needs *WebP Image Extensions* | native |
| **HEIC / HEIF** | needs the HEIF extension, or run `scripts/heic2jpg.sh` | native |

Wallpaper Engine and older wallpaper tools generally accept static WebP, but verify before relying on it for dynamic sets.

---

## Known issues

- **5.68 GB is still above GitHub's 5 GB comfort line.** Going lower would mean re-encoding JPEGs (second-generation loss) or splitting the archive — neither is planned.
- **53 exact-duplicate groups (107 MiB) remain on purpose.** These are copies inside curated sets (for example the Windows 11 theme folders referenced by `Desktop.ini`), not accidents.
- **~70 legacy images below 1280 px** remain in `2018-2020 Wallpaper`; a future cleanup candidate.
- **GitHub may keep reporting ~9 GB** after the push until it garbage-collects the old objects. Fresh clones are already 5.7 GB.
- **Old releases (v1.0.0–v4.1.0) now point at rewritten tags**, so their ZIP/tarball contains WebP instead of PNG.
- One ultrawide filename collision was suffixed: `1201491 (2).jpg`.

---

## Verification

- `git fsck --full` — clean
- `python3 scripts/stats.py --check` — README matches the working tree
- `find . -name '*.png'` — zero results
- 0 ultrawide images remain outside `Ultrawide Wallpapers/`
- Every image's content matches its extension (HEIC excluded — the decoder was not available locally)

---

## Links

[README](README.md) · [Migration guide](MIGRATION.md) · [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [License](LICENSE)

# v5.0.0 — 5.8 GB 版本

**发布：** 2026-10-21 · **上一版：** v4.1.0（2026-08）

> **破坏性变更：** 仓库历史已于 2026-10-21 重写，所有 commit 与 tag 都换了 SHA，约 480 个文件迁移。旧的 clone / fork 无法直接 `git pull`，处理方法见 **[MIGRATION.md](MIGRATION.md)**。

## 数字对比

| | v4.1.0（2026-08） | v5.0.0 |
|---|---|---|
| Git 仓库 | 9.55 GB | **5.68 GiB** |
| 工作区 | 10.23 GiB | **5.81 GiB** |
| 图片 | 3,087 | **2,685** |
| 视频 | 36 | **18** |
| 顶层文件夹 | 27 | **28** |
| PNG | 703 个（4.0 GiB） | **0** |
| WebP | 4 个 | **641** |

删掉的图片全部是"另一处仍有同一张"的重复，没有丢失独有内容。

## 为什么

历史里的 **99.6% 对象就是当前文件**，所以：

- `--depth 1` 无效——全库只有 11 个不可达对象；
- `git gc` 无效——没有垃圾可回收；
- 删文件也无效——旧 commit 仍引用着 blob。

**只有重写历史，才能把那 3.6 GB 的 PNG 从 `.git` 里真正拿掉。** 另外 1.1 GB 来自 `Year of 2021/`——它与 `2021 Wallpaper/` 逐字节相同。

## 新增

| 通道 | 数量 | 内容 |
|---|---|---|
| `Phone Wallpapers/` | 173 张 | iOS / Android / NASA Artemis II / 杂项 |
| `Ultrawide Wallpapers/` | 185 张 | `21x9` 142 · `32x9` 33 · `Panorama` 10 |
| `Social Assets/` | 125 个 | The Crew 2 物料、头像、杂项下载 |

超宽判定：宽高比 ≥ 2.05:1 且 ≥ 2560×1000。

## 画质

样本 PSNR **38.06 dB** / SSIM **0.9823**；随机 30 张中位 38.3 dB、最低 32.1 dB。正常观看距离无差别，1:1 放大时硬边缘会略软。**有损且不可逆**，原始 PNG 母版已不在仓库中。

## 升级

| 你的情况 | 做法 |
|---|---|
| 普通 clone，无本地提交 | `git fetch origin && git reset --hard origin/main` |
| fork，无自定义提交 | GitHub → Sync fork → Discard commits |
| fork，有自定义提交 | `git rebase --onto upstream/main 95d3b2c main` |
| 还没 clone | `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/MilesCorporate/The-Wallpaper-Collection.git` |

完整步骤、patch 方案与"旧路径 → 新路径"对照表见 **[MIGRATION.md](MIGRATION.md)**。

## 已知问题

- **5.68 GB 仍高于 GitHub 5 GB 建议线**；要再降只能重编码 JPEG 或拆分仓库，目前都不做。
- **53 组精确重复（107 MiB）是有意保留的**——套装内的副本（如 `Desktop.ini` 引用的 Windows 11 主题），不是漏删。
- `2018-2020 Wallpaper` 里还有约 **70 张 1280px 以下**的旧图，留待后续清理。
- 推送后 GitHub 网页体积可能仍显示约 9 GB，直到它回收旧对象；新 clone 已经是 5.7 GB。
- 旧版本（v1.0.0–v4.1.0）的 tag 已重写，其 ZIP 中是 WebP 而非 PNG。
- 一个超宽文件重名冲突，已加后缀：`1201491 (2).jpg`。

## 验证

- `git fsck --full` 无错误
- `python3 scripts/stats.py --check` 通过
- `find . -name '*.png'` 结果为 0
- `Ultrawide Wallpapers/` 之外无遗漏超宽图
- 所有文件内容与扩展名一致（HEIC 除外，本地缺解码器）
